meta.identityPolicy: Exact raw source names remain distinct. Simplified aliases affect display and search only.
meta.canonicalPolicy: Prefer visually reviewed main rows, then main rows, then the most frequent exact source vector. Always select a real source record; never average vectors.
meta.examplePolicy: PDF page 38 is retained as a teaching example and excluded from recommendation vectors, counts, and all edges.
meta.relationPolicy: Shared aroma marks apply only between a table's main ingredient and its paired row. They do not propagate to other tables or combinations.
meta.chartPolicy: Charts may count category marks or coverage; they must not describe them as intensity, concentration, sensory contribution, or recipe proportion.
meta.nameReviewPolicy: Corrections and unchanged confirmations apply only to explicitly reviewed recordId rows. Ingredient display uses the canonical row's reviewed name; raw identities, IDs, and all other occurrences remain unchanged. Unresolved canonical names are excluded; pairing edges additionally require both exact source names to be eligible.
meta.visualFamilyPolicy: Keyword-derived browse/art grouping only; not a verified taxonomy or substitute for ingredient identity.
meta.recipePolicy: Generated combinations are test candidates, not validated recipes, dose recommendations, safety assessments, or predictions of liking.
